name: HB-2 best-of-n exhaustive smoke
purpose: Fix Item124's best-of-n cap1 limitation by making the best-of-n runner budget-exhaustive by default, adding batched sampling for practicality, and running a small B*-only exhaustive smoke on sudoku and graph_color. This validates true budget exhaustion semantics: sampling continues until the next attempt would exceed budget_B, not until a fixed attempt cap. It is still not a final HB-2 curve because n=4 and futoshiki/LFS/ToT/RAP are not completed.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC — HB-2 External No-Train Matched-Budget Comparison (consolidated, v1)

code_added_used.change: Changes best-of-n default to budget-exhaustive mode when max_samples_per_budget=0 and adds batched sampling via sample_batch_size.
Runs a small B*-only exhaustive smoke with no sample cap and batched sampling.

commands.purpose: Run budget-exhaustive best-of-n smoke on sudoku and graph_color.

headline.sudoku: n=4 smoke at B*=28070 exhausted budget with mean_attempts=90.5 and solve=0/4; best official partial scores were around 0.48-0.54.
headline.graph_color: n=4 smoke at B*=32895 exhausted budget with mean_attempts=61.75 and solve=0/4.
headline.semantics: Rows ended BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, not ATTEMPT_CAP, confirming the runner now samples until budget exhaustion.
headline.single_next_move: Scale best-of-n exhaustive B* / grid to n=64, then port/run LFS and ToT/RAP before final HB-2 read.

gate_outcomes.number: max_samples_per_budget=0 produced BUDGET_EXHAUSTED rows with ~90 sudoku attempts and ~62 graph_color attempts at B*.
n=4 smoke only; futoshiki not run; LFS/ToT/RAP not ported/run.

decision.next_step_routing: Use the fixed runner for n=64 best-of-n sweeps. Keep HB-2 open until best-of-n, LFS, ToT, and RAP are run or final-not-run with provenance.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not complete HB-2 and does not compare against the full no-train frontier. It is only a budget-exhaustive smoke for the direct best-of-n runner.
honesty.scope_limit: n=4 and only sudoku/graph_color at B*. Futoshiki is omitted from this smoke because B*=3.2M implies thousands of direct samples per instance.
honesty.cap_note: Item124 cap1 was a useful harness smoke but used ATTEMPT_CAP; this item fixes the runner semantics so future best-of-n results can exhaust budget.
honesty.external_limit: LFS, ToT, RAP, and First Finish are still not ported/run.
